confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Taiwan price levels for a mid-sized east-coast tourist city, for July 2026. No live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with season and events. FX provenance is weak: the 2026-10-14 figure came from a search snippet attributed to the RBA homepage whose labels were jumbled, and a third-party site gave 0.6979 for 9 October, so verify against the RBA F11.1 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other mid-sized Taiwanese cities and east-coast tourist towns, priced below Taipei and Taichung. Beer and cocktail anchors use the local price relationship to restaurant meals because direct knowledge of bar prices is limited.
